==== 7387 project/src/gen/spec.ts
// Dynamic worlds and objects as DATA. A story that needs a location the built-in worlds cannot stage gets a
// `world.json` (rooms with openings, terrain + paths, objects, scatter, light fixtures, places) and, for
// objects the library lacks, `objects/<id>.json` (compound objects from primitives). The engine builds the
// 3D set, the camera space, collision, navigation and the light rig from these — no code per story.

export type V2 = [number, number];
export type V3 = [number, number, number];

// ── objects ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** Named material presets, or a custom material. Presets: wood, darkwood, steel, chrome, aluminium,
 *  plastic:#hex, paint:#hex, fabric:#hex, rubber, glass, ceramic, paper, leaf:#hex, bark, stone, metal:#hex,
 *  emissive:#hex, cloth:#hex (woven). */
export type MatSpec = string | { color?: string; roughness?: number; metal?: number; emissive?: string; glow?: number; opacity?: number; texture?: "weave" | "planks" | "tiles" | "noise" };

export type PartSpec = {
  shape: "box" | "cyl" | "cone" | "sphere" | "torus" | "capsule" | "rod" | "lathe" | "plane" | "text" | "pile";
  /** box: [w, h, d]; plane: [w, h] */
  size?: number[];
  /** cyl/cone/sphere/capsule/rod radius; cyl top radius = r, bottom = r2 (default r) */
  r?: number; r2?: number;
  /** cyl/cone/capsule height */
  h?: number;
  /** torus: ring radius R, tube r, arc (rad) */
  R?: number; arc?: number;
  /** rod from → to (a tube between two points) */
  from?: V3; to?: V3;
  /** lathe profile [[radius, y], …] around Y */
  profile?: V2[];
  /** text on a plane (signs): the words, colours */
  text?: string; ink?: string; bg?: string;
  /** pile: `count` small round items (radius r) heaped inside `size`, coloured from `colors` */
  count?: number; colors?: string[]; seed?: number;
  /** rounded box corner */
  round?: number;
  at?: V3;
  /** rotation in degrees [x, y, z] */
  rot?: V3;
  /** non-uniform scale */
  scale?: V3;
  mat?: MatSpec;
  /** repeat the part n times, moving by `step` (and rotating by `stepRot` degrees) each time; with
   *  `around: true` the copies swing around the object's vertical axis by stepRot[1] (radial legs, spokes) */
  repeat?: { n: number; step?: V3; stepRot?: V3; around?: boolean };
  /** also add the part mirrored across this axis */
  mirror?: "x" | "z";
  /** only shown when this object state is > 0.5 (e.g. "open", "on") */
  when?: string;
  /** glow follows this object state 0..1 */
  glowState?: string;
  castShadow?: boolean;
};

export type ObjectSpec = {
  id: string;
  doc: string;
  parts: PartSpec[];
  /** named points in object space: "seat", "push" (handles), "top" (surface), "grab", "handle", "front" */
  anchors?: Record<string, V3>;
  /** a person can stand here (floor-level items like rugs) */
  walkable?: boolean;
  /** footprint/bounds override [w, h, d]; normally computed from the parts */
  bounds?: V3;
  /** carried in one hand */
  hand?: boolean;
  /** states with defaults (doors "open", lamps "on") */
  states?: Record<string, number>;
};

// ── worlds ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type OpeningSpec = {
  /** wall of the room: north (−z side), south (+z), west (−x), east (+x) */
  wall: "north" | "south" | "west" | "east";
  /** position along the wall (world x for north/south, world z for west/east) */
  at: number;
  type: "door" | "double-door" | "window" | "arch";
  w?: number; h?: number; sill?: number;
  id?: string;
  /** door with a glass panel */
  glass?: boolean;
  /** text sign above it */
  sign?: string;
  /** door swings into this room (+1) or out (−1) */
  swing?: 1 | -1;
};

export type RoomSpec = {
  id: string;
  /** floor rectangle [x0, z0, x1, z1] and floor height */
  rect: [number, number, number, number];
  y?: number;
  height?: number;
  floor?: string;
  walls?: string;
  /** lower wall band colour (wainscot) */
  wainscot?: string;
  /** handrail along the walls (hospitals) */
  handrail?: string;
  ceiling?: string | "none";
  openings?: OpeningSpec[];
  /** walls not built (open sides, e.g. a market hall) */
  open?: ("north" | "south" | "west" | "east")[];
};

export type PathSpec = { points: V2[]; width?: number; material?: string; id?: string };

export type ObjectUse = {
  use: string;
  id?: string;
  /** [x, z] on the floor/ground, or [x, y, z] */
  at: V2 | V3;
  yaw?: number;
  scale?: number;
  /** stand it on another object's anchor ("table-1:top") */
  on?: string;
  states?: Record<string, number>;
  /** extra colour override for library objects that support it */
  color?: string;
  /** a variant/parameter string for library objects (e.g. goods "tomato") */
  variant?: string;
};

export type ScatterSpec = { use: string; count: number; area: [number, number, number, number]; avoid?: ("paths" | "rooms" | "objects")[]; minDist?: number; scale?: [number, number]; seed?: number; variant?: string };

export type FixtureSpec = {
  type: "panel" | "tube" | "bulb" | "lamp-post" | "string" | "spot" | "exit-sign" | "lantern" | "fire" | "screen";
  at: V3;
  /** string lights: to point */
  to?: V3;
  color?: string;
  /** light strength (1 = normal for the type) */
  i?: number;
  /** a set prop that switches/dims it (0..1) */
  prop?: string;
  /** flickers (broken tube) */
  flicker?: boolean;
  /** spot direction target */
  target?: V3;
  id?: string;
};

export type GroundSpec = { size: number; material?: string; hills?: number; seed?: number; y?: number };
export type SkySpec = { sun?: V3 };

/** `bed`: lie here (lie / sleep / wake / sitUp) — `head`: [x, z] of the pillow end, `y`: mattress top height */
export type MarkSpec = { at: V2 | V3; yaw?: number; seat?: number; bed?: { head: V2; y: number }; doc?: string };

export type PlaceSpec = {
  doc: string;
  kind?: "interior" | "exterior";
  /** blocking + camera area [x0, z0, x1, z1] (default: the rooms named in `rooms`, or the whole world) */
  area?: [number, number, number, number];
  rooms?: string[];
  marks?: Record<string, MarkSpec>;
  pois?: Record<string, V3>;
  view?: string;
  ambience?: string;
  surface?: string;
  /** establishing hint: where to look from [cx, cy, cz, radius, height, yaw] */
  establish?: [number, number, number, number, number, number];
};

export type PropSpec = { default: number; doc: string; sfx?: { up?: string; down?: string }; door?: string; lights?: string[] };

export type WorldSpec = {
  id: string;
  doc: string;
  times: string[];

  ground?: GroundSpec;
  paths?: PathSpec[];
  objects?: ObjectUse[];
  scatter?: ScatterSpec[];
  lights?: FixtureSpec[];
  /** buildings seen from outside: simple massing with windows, signs */
  buildings?: { rect: [number, number, number, number]; height: number; color?: string; roof?: string; sign?: string; windows?: boolean; y?: number }[];
  places: Record<string, PlaceSpec>;
  props?: Record<string, PropSpec>;
  /** atmosphere: fog 0..1, wind 0..1, interior ambient light colour */
  fog?: number;

};

==== 4099 project/src/kits/worldforge/geo.ts
// Small geometry kit for architecture: struts between points, merged lattices, lathe and
// arch profiles, geodesic frames. Geometries are cached by key so a film builds each once.

import {
  BufferGeometry,
  CylinderGeometry,
  IcosahedronGeometry,
  LatheGeometry,
  Matrix4,
  Quaternion,
  Shape,
  SphereGeometry,
  TorusGeometry,
  Vector2,
  Vector3,
} from "three";
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from "three/examples/jsm/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js";
import { mergeGeometries } from "three/examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js";

const cache = new Map<string, BufferGeometry>();
export const cached = <G extends BufferGeometry>(key: string, make: () => G): G => {
  let g = cache.get(key);
  if (!g) {
    g = make();
    cache.set(key, g);
  }
  return g as G;
};

export const cyl = (rt: number, rb: number, h: number, seg = 32, open = false, ts = 0, tl = Math.PI * 2) =>
  cached(`cyl${rt},${rb},${h},${seg},${open},${ts},${tl}`, () => new CylinderGeometry(rt, rb, h, seg, 1, open, ts, tl));
export const box = (w: number, h: number, d: number, r = 0.04, seg = 2) =>
  cached(`box${w},${h},${d},${r}`, () => new RoundedBoxGeometry(w, h, d, seg, Math.min(r, w / 2.01, h / 2.01, d / 2.01)));
export const sphere = (r: number, ws = 32, hs = 16, phiLen = Math.PI * 2, thetaLen = Math.PI) =>
  cached(`sph${r},${ws},${hs},${phiLen},${thetaLen}`, () => new SphereGeometry(r, ws, hs, 0, phiLen, 0, thetaLen));
export const torus = (R: number, r: number, rs = 8, ts = 48, arc = Math.PI * 2) =>
  cached(`tor${R},${r},${rs},${ts},${arc}`, () => new TorusGeometry(R, r, rs, ts, arc));
export const lathe = (key: string, pts: [number, number][], seg = 64) =>
  cached(`lathe${key}`, () => new LatheGeometry(pts.map(([x, y]) => new Vector2(x, y)), seg));

const UP = new Vector3(0, 1, 0);
/** A cylinder from p to q (world-free; positions in the caller's frame). */
export const strutGeo = (p: Vector3, q: Vector3, r: number, seg = 6) => {
  const d = new Vector3().subVectors(q, p);
  const len = d.length();
  const g = new CylinderGeometry(r, r, len, seg, 1, false);
  const m = new Matrix4().compose(
    new Vector3().addVectors(p, q).multiplyScalar(0.5),
    new Quaternion().setFromUnitVectors(UP, d.normalize()),
    new Vector3(1, 1, 1),
  );
  g.applyMatrix4(m);
  return g;
};

export const merged = (key: string, make: () => BufferGeometry[]) =>
  cached(key, () => {
    const parts = make().map((g) => (g.index ? g.toNonIndexed() : g));
    for (const p of parts) {
      for (const name of Object.keys(p.attributes)) if (name !== "position" && name !== "normal" && name !== "uv") p.deleteAttribute(name);
    }
    return mergeGeometries(parts, false)!;
  });

/** Geodesic frame over the upper hemisphere (edges of a subdivided icosahedron). */
export const geodesicFrame = (R: number, detail: number, strutR: number) =>
  merged(`geo${R},${detail},${strutR}`, () => {
    const ico = new IcosahedronGeometry(R, detail);
    const p = ico.attributes.position;
    const key = (v: Vector3) => `${v.x.toFixed(3)},${v.y.toFixed(3)},${v.z.toFixed(3)}`;
    const edges = new Map<string, [Vector3, Vector3]>();
    for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i += 3) {
      const tri = [0, 1, 2].map((k) => new Vector3(p.getX(i + k), p.getY(i + k), p.getZ(i + k)));
      for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        const a = tri[k], b = tri[(k + 1) % 3];
        if (a.y < -0.01 || b.y < -0.01) continue;
        const ka = key(a), kb = key(b);
        const id = ka < kb ? ka + "|" + kb : kb + "|" + ka;
        if (!edges.has(id)) edges.set(id, [a, b]);
      }
    }
    return [...edges.values()].map(([a, b]) => strutGeo(a, b, strutR, 5));
  });

/** Arch outline (flat sides, rounded roof) in the x-y plane, base on y = 0. */
export const archShape = (w: number, h: number, shoulder: number, inset = 0) => {
  const s = new Shape();
  const hw = w / 2 - inset;
  s.moveTo(-hw, inset > 0 ? 0 : 0);
  s.lineTo(-hw, h - shoulder);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(-hw, h - inset, 0, h - inset);
  s.quadraticCurveTo(hw, h - inset, hw, h - shoulder);
  s.lineTo(hw, 0);
  s.lineTo(-hw, 0);
  return s;
};

==== 6674 project/src/kits/worldforge/heightfield.ts
// Height-field toolkit: graded grids, bilinear lookup, baked sun visibility + ambient occlusion.
//
// A WORLDFORGE terrain is one analytic height function sampled on two graded grids: a dense
// "near" patch where the camera travels (sub-metre at the hero location, coarser toward its
// edges) and a coarse "far" patch out to the horizon. Grid spacing grows exponentially away
// from the origin, so detail is spent where the camera is. Because the sun never moves within
// a film, terrain self-shadowing and AO are baked once per grid vertex (pure CPU, seeded) —
// long mountain and dune shadows cost nothing per frame and can never flicker.

export type Axis = {
  n: number;
  /** Index of coordinate 0. */
  c: number;
  coord: Float64Array;
  /** Fractional index of a coordinate (inverse of the spacing map). */
  inv: (x: number) => number;
};

/** Spacing s(x) = s0 + k·|x|: a graded axis covering [min, max] with x = 0 on a grid line. */
export const expAxis = (min: number, max: number, s0: number, k: number): Axis => {
  const uOf = (x: number) => (Math.sign(x) * Math.log(1 + (k * Math.abs(x)) / s0)) / k;
  const lo = Math.ceil(-uOf(min));
  const hi = Math.ceil(uOf(max));
  const n = lo + hi + 1;
  const coord = new Float64Array(n);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const u = i - lo;
    coord[i] = (Math.sign(u) * (s0 / k)) * (Math.exp(k * Math.abs(u)) - 1);
  }
  return { n, c: lo, coord, inv: (x: number) => lo + uOf(x) };
};

export type Grid = {
  ax: Axis;
  az: Axis;
  /** Heights, row-major: index = j * ax.n + i (i along x, j along z). */
  h: Float32Array;
  minX: number;
  maxX: number;
  minZ: number;
  maxZ: number;
};

export const makeGrid = (ax: Axis, az: Axis, height: (x: number, z: number) => number): Grid => {
  const h = new Float32Array(ax.n * az.n);
  for (let j = 0; j < az.n; j++) {
    const z = az.coord[j];
    for (let i = 0; i < ax.n; i++) h[j * ax.n + i] = height(ax.coord[i], z);
  }
  return { ax, az, h, minX: ax.coord[0], maxX: ax.coord[ax.n - 1], minZ: az.coord[0], maxZ: az.coord[az.n - 1] };
};

export const inside = (g: Grid, x: number, z: number, margin = 0) =>
  x > g.minX + margin && x < g.maxX - margin && z > g.minZ + margin && z < g.maxZ - margin;

/** Bilinear height lookup in grid-index space (clamped to the grid). */
export const lookup = (g: Grid, x: number, z: number) => {
  const nx = g.ax.n, nz = g.az.n;
  let fi = g.ax.inv(x), fj = g.az.inv(z);
  if (fi < 0) fi = 0; else if (fi > nx - 1.0001) fi = nx - 1.0001;
  if (fj < 0) fj = 0; else if (fj > nz - 1.0001) fj = nz - 1.0001;
  const i = fi | 0, j = fj | 0;
  // Linear in true coordinates within the cell (the mesh is linear there too).
  const x0 = g.ax.coord[i], x1 = g.ax.coord[i + 1];
  const z0 = g.az.coord[j], z1 = g.az.coord[j + 1];
  let tx = (x - x0) / (x1 - x0), tz = (z - z0) / (z1 - z0);
  tx = tx < 0 ? 0 : tx > 1 ? 1 : tx;
  tz = tz < 0 ? 0 : tz > 1 ? 1 : tz;
  const k = j * nx + i;
  const a = g.h[k] + (g.h[k + 1] - g.h[k]) * tx;
  const b = g.h[k + nx] + (g.h[k + nx + 1] - g.h[k + nx]) * tx;
  return a + (b - a) * tz;
};

/** Height at any point: the near grid where it exists, otherwise the far grid. */
export const makeWorldHeight = (near: Grid, far: Grid) => (x: number, z: number) =>
  inside(near, x, z) ? lookup(near, x, z) : lookup(far, x, z);

export type BakeOpts = {
  /** Unit vector toward the sun. */
  sun: [number, number, number];
  /** Highest point in the world: rays above it can stop. */
  maxH: number;
  maxDist: number;
  /** Penumbra half-width as a slope (tan of angle). */
  soft: number;
};

/**
 * Sun visibility per grid vertex, 0..1 with soft penumbrae: march toward the sun and keep the
 * smallest clearance angle between the ray and the terrain.
 */
export const bakeSun = (g: Grid, height: (x: number, z: number) => number, o: BakeOpts) => {
  const [lx, ly, lz] = o.sun;
  const lh = Math.hypot(lx, lz);
  const dx = lx / lh, dz = lz / lh, tanE = ly / lh;
  const nx = g.ax.n, nz = g.az.n;
  const out = new Float32Array(nx * nz);
  for (let j = 0; j < nz; j++) {
    const z = g.az.coord[j];
    const sz = j > 0 ? z - g.az.coord[j - 1] : g.az.coord[1] - z;
    for (let i = 0; i < nx; i++) {
      const x = g.ax.coord[i];
      const sx = i > 0 ? x - g.ax.coord[i - 1] : g.ax.coord[1] - x;
      const spacing = Math.max(sx, sz);
      const h0 = g.h[j * nx + i] + 0.12 + 0.04 * spacing;
      let vis = 1;
      let s = spacing * 0.8;
      while (s < o.maxDist) {
        const ry = h0 + s * tanE;
        if (ry > o.maxH) break;
        const th = height(x + dx * s, z + dz * s);
        const v = 0.5 + (ry - th) / s / (2 * o.soft);
        if (v < vis) {
          vis = v;
          if (vis <= 0) { vis = 0; break; }
        }
        s = s * 1.045 + 0.3 * spacing;
      }
      out[j * nx + i] = vis > 1 ? 1 : vis;
    }
  }
  return out;
};

/** Horizon-based ambient occlusion per vertex (8 directions, exponential steps). */
export const bakeAO = (g: Grid, height: (x: number, z: number) => number, radius: number, strength: number) => {
  const nx = g.ax.n, nz = g.az.n;
  const out = new Float32Array(nx * nz);
  const dirs = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, k) => [Math.cos((k / 8) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.3), Math.sin((k / 8) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.3)]);
  const steps: number[] = [];
  for (let s = 1.2; s < radius; s *= 1.6) steps.push(s);
  for (let j = 0; j < nz; j++) {
    const z = g.az.coord[j];
    for (let i = 0; i < nx; i++) {
      const x = g.ax.coord[i];
      const h0 = g.h[j * nx + i];
      let occ = 0;
      for (const [cx, cz] of dirs) {
        let m = 0;
        for (const s of steps) {
          const t = (height(x + cx * s, z + cz * s) - h0) / s;
          if (t > m) m = t;
        }
        occ += m / Math.sqrt(1 + m * m);
      }
      const ao = 1 - (occ / 8) * strength;
      out[j * nx + i] = ao < 0 ? 0 : ao;
    }
  }
  return out;
};

/** Grid-space normal (world units), written into `out` as xyz per vertex. */
export const gridNormals = (g: Grid) => {
  const nx = g.ax.n, nz = g.az.n;
  const out = new Float32Array(nx * nz * 3);
  for (let j = 0; j < nz; j++) {
    const j0 = j > 0 ? j - 1 : j, j1 = j < nz - 1 ? j + 1 : j;
    const dz = g.az.coord[j1] - g.az.coord[j0];
    for (let i = 0; i < nx; i++) {
      const i0 = i > 0 ? i - 1 : i, i1 = i < nx - 1 ? i + 1 : i;
      const dx = g.ax.coord[i1] - g.ax.coord[i0];
      const gx = (g.h[j * nx + i1] - g.h[j * nx + i0]) / dx;
      const gz = (g.h[j1 * nx + i] - g.h[j0 * nx + i]) / dz;
      const l = Math.hypot(gx, 1, gz);
      const k = (j * nx + i) * 3;
      out[k] = -gx / l;
      out[k + 1] = 1 / l;
      out[k + 2] = -gz / l;
    }
  }
  return out;
};

==== 3442 project/src/kits/worldforge/noise.ts
// Seeded, deterministic noise for world-building. Every function is a pure function of its
// inputs (no Math.random), so terrain, scatter and textures are identical in every render tab.

export const mulberry32 = (seed: number) => {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = a;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
};

/** Integer hash → [0, 1). */
export const hash2 = (x: number, y: number, seed = 0) => {
  let h = (Math.imul(x | 0, 374761393) + Math.imul(y | 0, 668265263) + Math.imul(seed | 0, 2147483647)) | 0;
  h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177);
  h ^= h >>> 16;
  return (h >>> 0) / 4294967296;
};

// 2D gradient (Perlin) noise with a seeded permutation table.
const P = new Uint16Array(512);
const GX = new Float32Array(256);
const GY = new Float32Array(256);
{
  const rnd = mulberry32(0x6a52);
  const p = Array.from({ length: 256 }, (_, i) => i);
  for (let i = 255; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(rnd() * (i + 1));
    [p[i], p[j]] = [p[j], p[i]];
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < 512; i++) P[i] = p[i & 255];
  for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
    const a = rnd() * Math.PI * 2;
    GX[i] = Math.cos(a);
    GY[i] = Math.sin(a);
  }
}

/** Perlin noise, roughly in [-1, 1]. */
export const noise2 = (x: number, y: number) => {
  const xi = Math.floor(x), yi = Math.floor(y);
  const xf = x - xi, yf = y - yi;
  const X = xi & 255, Y = yi & 255;
  const a = P[X] + Y, b = P[X + 1] + Y;
  const g00 = P[a], g01 = P[a + 1], g10 = P[b], g11 = P[b + 1];
  const d00 = GX[g00] * xf + GY[g00] * yf;
  const d10 = GX[g10] * (xf - 1) + GY[g10] * yf;
  const d01 = GX[g01] * xf + GY[g01] * (yf - 1);
  const d11 = GX[g11] * (xf - 1) + GY[g11] * (yf - 1);
  const u = xf * xf * xf * (xf * (xf * 6 - 15) + 10);
  const v = yf * yf * yf * (yf * (yf * 6 - 15) + 10);
  const x0 = d00 + (d10 - d00) * u;
  const x1 = d01 + (d11 - d01) * u;
  return (x0 + (x1 - x0) * v) * 1.414;
};

// Octaves are rotated ~37° against each other so the lattice never lines up.
const RC = 0.8, RS = 0.6;

/** Fractal sum, roughly in [-1, 1]. */
export const fbm = (x: number, y: number, oct: number, gain = 0.5) => {
  let s = 0, a = 1, n = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < oct; i++) {
    s += a * noise2(x, y);
    n += a;
    const nx = (RC * x - RS * y) * 2.03 + 17.1;
    y = (RS * x + RC * y) * 2.03 + 3.7;
    x = nx;
    a *= gain;
  }
  return s / n;
};

/** Ridged multifractal in [0, 1]: sharp crests, eroded-looking valleys. */
export const ridged = (x: number, y: number, oct: number, gain = 0.5) => {
  let s = 0, a = 1, n = 0, w = 1;
  for (let i = 0; i < oct; i++) {
    let r = 1 - Math.abs(noise2(x, y));
    r *= r;
    r *= w;
    w = Math.min(1, r * 1.8);
    s += a * r;
    n += a;
    const nx = (RC * x - RS * y) * 2.07 + 31.3;
    y = (RS * x + RC * y) * 2.07 + 7.9;
    x = nx;
    a *= gain;
  }
  return s / n;
};

export const clamp01 = (x: number) => (x < 0 ? 0 : x > 1 ? 1 : x);
export const smooth = (a: number, b: number, x: number) => {
  const t = clamp01((x - a) / (b - a));
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
};
export const lerp = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => a + (b - a) * t;
/** Polynomial smooth minimum. */
export const smin = (a: number, b: number, k: number) => {
  const h = clamp01(0.5 + (0.5 * (b - a)) / k);
  return lerp(b, a, h) - k * h * (1 - h);
};

==== 2090 project/src/kits/worldforge/path.ts
// Plan-view paths for vehicles and people: Catmull-Rom through the points, sampled by arc
// length so speed along the path is exact (wheels and footsteps can be derived from distance).

export type P2 = [number, number];

export type PlanPath = {
  length: number;
  /** Position and unit direction at arc length s (clamped). */
  at: (s: number) => { p: P2; dir: P2 };
};

const cr = (a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number, t: number) =>
  0.5 * (2 * b + (-a + c) * t + (2 * a - 5 * b + 4 * c - d) * t * t + (-a + 3 * b - 3 * c + d) * t * t * t);

export const planPath = (pts: P2[], perSeg = 40): PlanPath => {
  const n = pts.length;
  const get = (i: number) => pts[Math.max(0, Math.min(n - 1, i))];
  const samples: P2[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    const a = get(i - 1), b = get(i), c = get(i + 1), d = get(i + 2);
    for (let k = 0; k < perSeg; k++) {
      const t = k / perSeg;
      samples.push([cr(a[0], b[0], c[0], d[0], t), cr(a[1], b[1], c[1], d[1], t)]);
    }
  }
  samples.push(pts[n - 1]);
  const cum = [0];
  for (let i = 1; i < samples.length; i++) cum.push(cum[i - 1] + Math.hypot(samples[i][0] - samples[i - 1][0], samples[i][1] - samples[i - 1][1]));
  const length = cum[cum.length - 1];
  const at = (s: number) => {
    const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(length - 1e-6, s));
    let lo = 0, hi = cum.length - 1;
    while (hi - lo > 1) {
      const m = (lo + hi) >> 1;
      if (cum[m] <= x) lo = m;
      else hi = m;
    }
    const f = (x - cum[lo]) / Math.max(1e-9, cum[hi] - cum[lo]);
    const A = samples[lo], B = samples[hi];
    const dx = B[0] - A[0], dz = B[1] - A[1];
    const l = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1;
    return { p: [A[0] + dx * f, A[1] + dz * f] as P2, dir: [dx / l, dz / l] as P2 };
  };
  return { length, at };
};

/** Distance travelled with a smooth start: rest until t0, accelerate over `ramp`, then speed v. */
export const travel = (t: number, t0: number, ramp: number, v: number) => {
  if (t <= t0) return 0;
  const u = t - t0;
  if (u < ramp) return (v * u * u) / (2 * ramp);
  return v * (u - ramp / 2);
};

// Character bible sheet: frame 2k = look k full body (3/4), frame 2k+1 = its face. Neutral studio light.
import React from "react";
import { useCurrentFrame } from "remotion";
import { Stage } from "../cine/Stage.tsx";
import { Lights, P_OFF, S_OFF, type LightState } from "../cine/Lights.tsx";
import { CameraRig, FilmPost, GRADE0, type Cam } from "../cine/Post.tsx";
import { Character } from "../cine/character/Character.tsx";
import { restPose } from "../cine/character/pose.ts";
import { LOOKS, lookSpec } from "../cine/character/looks.ts";
import { phys } from "../cine/mats.ts";
import { box } from "../kits/worldforge/geo.ts";

export const CAST_SHEET_FRAMES = Object.keys(LOOKS).length * 2;

const L: LightState = {
  bg: "#9aa3ad", fog: { color: "#9aa3ad", density: 0.0 }, env: 0.5,
  hemi: { sky: "#dfe6ee", ground: "#5a5048", i: 0.9 },
  moon: { dir: [0.5, 0.8, 0.6], color: "#fff4e6", i: 2.6, box: { min: [-1.5, 0, -1.5], max: [1.5, 2.2, 1.5] } },
  spots: [S_OFF, S_OFF],
  pts: [{ pos: [-1.6, 1.8, 1.4], color: "#cfe0ff", i: 2.2, dist: 6 }, P_OFF, P_OFF, P_OFF, P_OFF, P_OFF],
};

  const names = Object.keys(LOOKS);
  const name = names[Math.floor(f / 2) % names.length];
  const face = f % 2 === 1;
  const spec = lookSpec(name, name);
  const p = restPose();

  const h = 1.8 * spec.scale;
  const cam: Cam = face
    ? { pos: [-0.25, h * 0.93, 0.62], target: [0, h * 0.91, 0], fov: 24 }
    : { pos: [-1.0, h * 0.62, 3.6], target: [0, h * 0.5, 0], fov: 32 };

    <Stage overlay={() => <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 40, top: 30, font: "600 40px Manrope", color: "#1d232b" }}>{name}</div>}>
      <Lights s={L} />
      <mesh geometry={box(8, 0.1, 8, 0.01)} material={phys("sheetFloor", { color: "#8a9099", roughness: 0.9 })} position={[0, -0.05, 0]} receiveShadow />
      <Character spec={spec} pose={p} t={1} />
      <CameraRig cam={cam} />
      <FilmPost cam={cam} grade={{ ...GRADE0, vignette: 0.1, grain: 0.004 }} frame={f} />
    </Stage>
  );
};

==== 2774 project/src/lookdev/ObjectSheet.tsx
// Object look sheet: frame 2k / 2k+1 = object k from the front-left and back-right, on a grey studio floor
// next to a 1.8 m person (scale check). Objects: the library registry + built-ins (sheet-list.json).
import React from "react";
import { useCurrentFrame } from "remotion";
import { Stage } from "../cine/Stage.tsx";
import { Lights, P_OFF, S_OFF, type LightState } from "../cine/Lights.tsx";
import { CameraRig, FilmPost, GRADE0, type Cam } from "../cine/Post.tsx";
import { Character } from "../cine/character/Character.tsx";
import { restPose } from "../cine/character/pose.ts";
import { lookSpec } from "../cine/character/looks.ts";
import { phys } from "../cine/mats.ts";
import { box } from "../kits/worldforge/geo.ts";
import { OBJECTS } from "../gen/objects/registry.ts";
import { objectInfo } from "../gen/build.ts";
import { Compound } from "../gen/objects/Compound.tsx";
import { Builtin } from "../gen/objects/builtin.tsx";
import LIST from "../gen/objects/sheet-list.json";

const L: LightState = {
  bg: "#9aa3ad", fog: { color: "#9aa3ad", density: 0.0 }, env: 0.5,
  hemi: { sky: "#dfe6ee", ground: "#5a5048", i: 0.9 },
  moon: { dir: [0.5, 0.8, 0.6], color: "#fff4e6", i: 2.6, box: { min: [-4, 0, -4], max: [4, 6, 4] } },
  spots: [S_OFF, S_OFF],
  pts: [{ pos: [-2.6, 2.6, 2.4], color: "#cfe0ff", i: 3.0, dist: 9 }, P_OFF, P_OFF, P_OFF, P_OFF, P_OFF],
};
export const OBJECT_SHEET_FRAMES = Math.max(2, (LIST as string[]).length * 2);

export const ObjectSheet: React.FC = () => {
  const f = useCurrentFrame();
  const names = LIST as string[];
  const id = names[Math.floor(f / 2)] ?? names[0];
  const objs = Object.fromEntries(OBJECTS.map((o) => [o.id, o]));
  let info;
  try { info = objectInfo(id, objs); } catch { return null; }
  const [w, h, d] = info.bounds;
  const R = Math.max(w, h * 1.1, d, 1.2) * 1.55 + 0.8;
  const a = f % 2 ? 2.4 : -0.7;
  const cy = Math.max(0.5, h * 0.45);
  const cam: Cam = { pos: [Math.sin(a) * R, cy + R * 0.38, Math.cos(a) * R], target: [0, cy * 0.85, 0], fov: 34 };
  const p = restPose();
  p.x = -(w / 2 + 0.45); p.yaw = 0.4;
  return (
    <Stage overlay={() => <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 40, top: 30, font: "600 40px Manrope", color: "#1d232b" }}>{id} · {w.toFixed(2)}×{h.toFixed(2)}×{d.toFixed(2)} m</div>}>
      <Lights s={L} />
      <mesh geometry={box(30, 0.1, 30, 0.01)} material={phys("osFloor", { color: "#8a9099", roughness: 0.9 })} position={[0, -0.05, 0]} receiveShadow />
      {info.builtin ? <Builtin id={id} /> : <Compound spec={objs[id]} />}
      {h < 4 ? <Character spec={lookSpec("ref", "pemuda")} pose={p} t={1} /> : null}
      <CameraRig cam={cam} />
      <FilmPost cam={cam} grade={{ ...GRADE0, vignette: 0.1, grain: 0.004 }} frame={f} />
    </Stage>
  );
};

==== 1876 project/src/lookdev/WorldLook.tsx
// World lookdev: one camera per frame over a world's places (establishing views + a few angles), with
// the set state given in props. Render with: node scripts/stills.mjs out/look/<world> 0,1,2,… world-<id>
import React from "react";
import { useCurrentFrame } from "remotion";
import { Stage } from "../cine/Stage.tsx";
import { Lights } from "../cine/Lights.tsx";
import { CameraRig, FilmPost, GRADE0, type Cam, type Grade } from "../cine/Post.tsx";
import { WORLDS } from "../worlds/index.ts";
import { SETS } from "../worlds/sets.tsx";
import { legalCam, type SetState } from "../worlds/types.ts";

export type LookView = { place: string; time: string; cam: Cam; s?: SetState; t?: number; label?: string };
export const NIGHT_GRADE: Grade = { ...GRADE0, exposure: 1.45, lift: [0.02, 0.03, 0.055], gain: [0.96, 1.0, 1.06], sat: 0.92, contrast: 1.06, vignette: 0.32, grain: 0.02, bloom: 0.3, bloomRadius: 0.55, bloomThreshold: 0.9 };

export const WorldLook: React.FC<{ world: string; views: LookView[] }> = ({ world, views }) => {
  const f = useCurrentFrame();
  const v = views[f % views.length];
  const W = WORLDS[world];
  const Set = SETS[world];
  const pl = W.places[v.place];
  const s: SetState = { ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(W.props).map(([k, p]) => [k, p.default])), ...v.s };
  const cam = { ...v.cam, pos: legalCam(pl, v.cam.pos) };
  const t = v.t ?? 3;
  return (
    <Stage overlay={() => <div style={{ position: "absolute", left: 30, top: 24, font: "600 30px Manrope", color: "#fff", textShadow: "0 2px 6px #000" }}>{v.label ?? `${v.place} · ${v.time}`}</div>}>
      <Lights s={W.light(v.place, v.time, s, t)} />
      <Set place={v.place} time={v.time} s={s} t={t} cam={cam} />
      <CameraRig cam={cam} />
      <FilmPost cam={cam} grade={v.time === "day" ? { ...GRADE0, exposure: 1.0 } : NIGHT_GRADE} frame={f} />
    </Stage>
  );
};

==== 2616 project/src/Root.tsx
import React from "react";
import { Composition } from "remotion";
import { PRESETS } from "./cine/Stage.tsx";
import { CAST_SHEET_FRAMES, CastSheet } from "./lookdev/CastSheet.tsx";
import { WorldLook } from "./lookdev/WorldLook.tsx";
import { OBJECT_SHEET_FRAMES, ObjectSheet } from "./lookdev/ObjectSheet.tsx";
import { COAST_VIEWS, KOS_VIEWS } from "./lookdev/views.ts";
import { Film } from "./film/Film.tsx";
import { compile } from "./director/compile.ts";
import { STORIES } from "./stories/registry.ts";

const { final } = PRESETS.landscape;

// Every story in src/stories/data (written by scripts/make.mjs) becomes <id>-preview and <id>-final:
// portrait (default) 540×960 @ 30 / 1080×1920 @ 60, landscape 960×540 @ 30 / 1920×1080 @ 60.
// Lookdev: cast-sheet, world-<id>, object-sheet (landscape).
// a story that does not compile (being edited, a typo) is left out instead of breaking every other story's render
const durationOf = (s: (typeof STORIES)[number]) => { try { return compile(s).duration; } catch (e) { console.warn(`story "${s.id}" skipped: ${(e as Error).message.split("\n")[0]}`); return null; } };

export const RemotionRoot: React.FC = () => (
  <>
    {STORIES.map((s) => {
      const d = durationOf(s);
      if (d === null) return null;
      const { draft, final } = PRESETS[s.format === "landscape" ? "landscape" : "portrait"];
      return (
        <React.Fragment key={s.id}>
          <Composition id={`${s.id}-preview`} component={Film} defaultProps={{ story: s, audio: s.audio }} durationInFrames={Math.round(d * draft.fps)} fps={draft.fps} width={draft.width} height={draft.height} />
          <Composition id={`${s.id}-final`} component={Film} defaultProps={{ story: s, audio: s.audio }} durationInFrames={Math.round(d * final.fps)} fps={final.fps} width={final.width} height={final.height} />
        </React.Fragment>
      );
    })}
    <Composition id="object-sheet" component={ObjectSheet} durationInFrames={OBJECT_SHEET_FRAMES} fps={1} width={final.width / 2} height={final.height / 2} />
    <Composition id="cast-sheet" component={CastSheet} durationInFrames={CAST_SHEET_FRAMES} fps={1} width={final.width / 2} height={final.height / 2} />
    <Composition id="world-coast" component={WorldLook} defaultProps={{ world: "coast", views: COAST_VIEWS }} durationInFrames={COAST_VIEWS.length} fps={1} width={final.width / 2} height={final.height / 2} />
    <Composition id="world-kos" component={WorldLook} defaultProps={{ world: "kos", views: KOS_VIEWS }} durationInFrames={KOS_VIEWS.length} fps={1} width={final.width / 2} height={final.height / 2} />
  </>
);

==== 26984 project/src/worlds/coast/Coast.tsx
// Coast world, picture side: sky, sea, the headland terrain with rocks and grass, fence and bench, the
// lighthouse (turning lamp + beams), the keeper's cottage (exterior + furnished interior) and the fishing
// boat whose lamps are "the light at sea". Pure function of (place, time, set state, t).

import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { BufferAttribute, BufferGeometry, Color, ConeGeometry, DoubleSide, IcosahedronGeometry, InstancedMesh, Matrix4, MeshStandardMaterial, Quaternion, Shape, ShapeGeometry, Vector3 } from "three";
import { box, cached, cyl, sphere, torus } from "../../kits/worldforge/geo.ts";
import { expAxis } from "../../kits/worldforge/heightfield.ts";
import { fbm, mulberry32 } from "../../kits/worldforge/noise.ts";
import { canvasTex, phys } from "../../cine/mats.ts";
import { Beam, Dust, Glow } from "../../cine/FX.tsx";
import { SKIES, SkyDome } from "../../cine/env/Sky.tsx";
import { Ocean, waveHeight, waveSlope } from "../../cine/env/Ocean.tsx";
import { Bed, Chair, Desk, Door, HoledWall, MAT, OilLamp, Shelf, Slab, WallClock, Window } from "../../cine/set/parts.tsx";
import type { Cam } from "../../cine/Post.tsx";
import type { SetState, V3 } from "../types.ts";
import { BED_AT, BENCH, BOAT, BOAT_YAW, COTTAGE, C_DOOR, C_WIN, DECK_Y, DESK, DESK_TOP, LAMP, LANTERN, LH, MOON, SEA_LIGHT, SUN_DAWN, TOP, beamAngle, coastZ, ground } from "./layout.ts";

// ── terrain ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const PATHS: [number, number, number, number][] = [[6.4, 0.6, 3.6, 0.0], [3.9, -0.2, 2.5, -6.4], [3.4, -2.6, 5.6, -5.2], [6.4, 0.6, 9.0, 4.5]];
const segDist = (x: number, z: number, [ax, az, bx, bz]: [number, number, number, number]) => {
  const dx = bx - ax, dz = bz - az, k = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((x - ax) * dx + (z - az) * dz) / (dx * dx + dz * dz)));
  return Math.hypot(x - ax - dx * k, z - az - dz * k);
};

const terrainGeo = () =>
  cached("coastTerrain", () => {
    const ax = expAxis(-260, 260, 0.4, 0.03), az = expAxis(-160, 260, 0.4, 0.03);
    const nx = ax.n, nz = az.n;
    const pos = new Float32Array(nx * nz * 3), col = new Float32Array(nx * nz * 3);
    const grass = new Color("#3e4a2c"), grass2 = new Color("#56603a"), path = new Color("#6e5d47"), rock = new Color("#5d5752"), wet = new Color("#26292a");
    const c = new Color();
    for (let j = 0; j < nz; j++) for (let i = 0; i < nx; i++) {
      const x = ax.coord[i], z = az.coord[j], h = ground(x, z), k = j * nx + i;
      pos[k * 3] = x; pos[k * 3 + 1] = h; pos[k * 3 + 2] = z;
      const e = 0.3, slope = Math.hypot(ground(x + e, z) - ground(x - e, z), ground(x, z + e) - ground(x, z - e)) / (2 * e);
      c.copy(grass).lerp(grass2, 0.5 + 0.5 * fbm(x * 0.15, z * 0.15, 3));
      const pd = Math.min(...PATHS.map((p) => segDist(x, z, p)));
      if (h > TOP - 0.5) c.lerp(path, Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (0.55 - pd) / 0.25)) * 0.9);
      c.lerp(rock, Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (slope - 0.7) / 0.6)));
      if (h < 1.6) c.lerp(wet, Math.min(1, (1.6 - h) / 1.6));
      col[k * 3] = c.r; col[k * 3 + 1] = c.g; col[k * 3 + 2] = c.b;
    }
    const idx = new Uint32Array((nx - 1) * (nz - 1) * 6);
    let n = 0;
    for (let j = 0; j < nz - 1; j++) for (let i = 0; i < nx - 1; i++) {
      const a = j * nx + i, b = a + 1, cc = a + nx, d = cc + 1;
      idx[n++] = a; idx[n++] = cc; idx[n++] = b; idx[n++] = b; idx[n++] = cc; idx[n++] = d;
    }
    const g = new BufferGeometry();
    g.setAttribute("position", new BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
    g.setAttribute("color", new BufferAttribute(col, 3));
    g.setIndex(new BufferAttribute(idx, 1));
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    g.computeBoundingSphere();
    return g;
  });
const terrainMat = new MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.95, metalness: 0 });

const rockGeo = () =>
  cached("coastRock", () => {
    const g = new IcosahedronGeometry(1, 2);
    const a = g.attributes.position;
    for (let i = 0; i < a.count; i++) {
      const v = new Vector3(a.getX(i), a.getY(i), a.getZ(i));
      v.multiplyScalar(1 + 0.28 * fbm(v.x * 1.7 + 3, v.y * 1.7 + v.z, 3));
      a.setXYZ(i, v.x, v.y * 0.75, v.z);
    }
    g.computeVertexNormals();
    return g;
  });
const rockMat = new MeshStandardMaterial({ color: "#4a4643", roughness: 0.92, flatShading: true });

const Rocks: React.FC = () => {
  const mesh = useMemo(() => {
    const r = mulberry32(31), n = 330;
    const m = new InstancedMesh(rockGeo(), rockMat, n);
    const M = new Matrix4(), q = new Quaternion(), c = new Color();
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const face = i % 7 < 3;
      const x = (face ? -45 : -95) + r() * (face ? 90 : 190), zc = coastZ(x);
      const z = face ? zc - 0.2 - r() * 1.4 : zc - 0.5 - r() * r() * 9, s = face ? 0.45 + r() * 0.9 : 0.8 + r() * 3.2;
      const y = face ? 0.5 + r() * (TOP - 2) : Math.max(ground(x, z), -1.2 + r() * 1.5);
      q.setFromAxisAngle(new Vector3(r(), r(), r()).normalize(), r() * 6);
      M.compose(new Vector3(x, y, z), q, new Vector3(s * (0.8 + r() * 0.6), s * (0.6 + r() * 0.6), s));
      m.setMatrixAt(i, M);
      m.setColorAt(i, c.setHSL(0.07, 0.06, (face ? 0.3 : 0.2) + r() * 0.12));
    }
    m.castShadow = true;
    m.receiveShadow = true;
    return m;
  }, []);
  return <primitive object={mesh} />;
};

const Grass: React.FC<{ t: number }> = ({ t }) => {
  const { mesh, base } = useMemo(() => {
    const r = mulberry32(77), base: [number, number, number, number, number][] = [];
    while (base.length < 2200) {
      const x = -26 + r() * 56, z = -12 + r() * 40, h = ground(x, z);
      if (h < TOP - 0.3 || z < coastZ(x) + 0.6) continue;
      if (x > COTTAGE.x0 - 0.4 && x < COTTAGE.x1 + 0.4 && z > COTTAGE.z0 - 0.4 && z < COTTAGE.z1 + 0.4) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(x, z) < LH.r0 + 0.8) continue;
      if (Math.min(...PATHS.map((p) => segDist(x, z, p))) < 0.6) continue;
      base.push([x, h, z, 0.6 + r() * 0.9, r() * 6.28]);
    }
    const g = cached("grassBlade", () => new ConeGeometry(0.05, 0.42, 4, 1).translate(0, 0.21, 0));
    const m = new InstancedMesh(g, new MeshStandardMaterial({ color: "#ffffff", roughness: 0.9 }), base.length);
    const c = new Color();
    base.forEach((_, i) => m.setColorAt(i, c.setHSL(0.2 + 0.05 * r(), 0.32, 0.17 + 0.08 * r())));
    m.receiveShadow = true;
    return { mesh: m, base };
  }, []);
  const M = new Matrix4(), q = new Quaternion(), e = new Vector3();
  base.forEach(([x, y, z, s, ph], i) => {
    const sway = 0.18 * Math.sin(t * 1.6 + x * 0.35 + ph * 0.3) + 0.08 * Math.sin(t * 3.1 + ph);
    q.setFromAxisAngle(e.set(1, 0, 0.3).normalize(), sway);
    M.compose(new Vector3(x, y - 0.02, z), q, new Vector3(s, s, s));
    mesh.setMatrixAt(i, M);
  });
  mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
  return <primitive object={mesh} />;
};

const Fence: React.FC = () => {
  const posts: V3[] = [];
  for (let x = -7; x <= 9.01; x += 2) posts.push([x, ground(x, coastZ(x) + 1.1), coastZ(x) + 1.1]);
  const wood = MAT.wood("#5a4a3a");
  return (
    <group>
      {posts.map((p, i) => <mesh key={i} geometry={box(0.09, 1.05, 0.09, 0.01)} material={wood} position={[p[0], p[1] + 0.5, p[2]]} castShadow />)}
      {posts.slice(1).map((p, i) => {
        const a = posts[i], dx = p[0] - a[0], dz = p[2] - a[2], L = Math.hypot(dx, dz), yaw = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
        return [0.5, 0.92].map((hh) => (
          <mesh key={`${i}${hh}`} geometry={box(0.05, 0.07, L, 0.01)} material={wood} position={[(a[0] + p[0]) / 2, (a[1] + p[1]) / 2 + hh, (a[2] + p[2]) / 2]} rotation={[0, yaw, 0]} castShadow />
        ));
      })}
    </group>
  );
};

const Bench: React.FC = () => {
  const w = MAT.wood("#6a5038");
  return (
    <group position={BENCH}>
      <Slab min={[-0.85, 0.42, -0.2]} max={[0.85, 0.47, 0.22]} m={w} />
      <Slab min={[-0.85, 0.52, 0.2]} max={[0.85, 0.9, 0.25]} m={w} />
      {[-0.7, 0.7].map((x) => <Slab key={x} min={[x - 0.04, 0, -0.18]} max={[x + 0.04, 0.42, 0.2]} m={MAT.steel()} />)}
    </group>
  );
};

// ── lighthouse ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const Lighthouse: React.FC<{ t: number; beam: number; dark: number; cam: Cam }> = ({ t, beam, dark, cam }) => {
  const white = phys("lhWhite", { color: "#e7e3d9", roughness: 0.7 }), red = phys("lhRed", { color: "#a3302a", roughness: 0.6 });
  const stone = phys("lhStone", { color: "#8a857c", roughness: 0.9 }), iron = phys("lhIron", { color: "#1d2124", roughness: 0.5, metalness: 0.6 });
  const rAt = (y: number) => LH.r0 + (LH.r1 - LH.r0) * (y / LH.h);
  const bands = [0.7, 4, 8, 12, LH.h];
  const a = beamAngle(t);
  const glass = phys(`lhGlass${Math.round(beam * dark * 10)}`, { color: "#cfe0ef", roughness: 0.05, transparent: true, opacity: 0.25, emissive: "#ffe8c0", emissiveIntensity: 0.12 * beam * dark, side: DoubleSide, depthWrite: false });
  const core = phys(`lhCore${Math.round(beam * 10)}`, { color: "#fff6e0", emissive: "#fff0d0", emissiveIntensity: 0.3 + 2 * beam, roughness: 0.2 });
  // the beam's flare toward the camera
  const toCam = new Vector3(cam.pos[0] - LAMP[0], 0, cam.pos[2] - LAMP[2]).normalize();
  const face = Math.max(...[0, Math.PI].map((o) => Math.max(0, -Math.sin(a + o) * toCam.x - Math.cos(a + o) * toCam.z)));
  const camD = Math.hypot(cam.pos[0] - LAMP[0], cam.pos[1] - LAMP[1], cam.pos[2] - LAMP[2]);
  const near = Math.min(1, Math.max(0.06, (camD - 3) / 25));
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={cyl(2.95, 3.05, 0.8, 40)} material={stone} position={[0, TOP + 0.3, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      {bands.slice(0, -1).map((y0, i) => {
        const y1 = bands[i + 1];
        return <mesh key={i} geometry={cyl(rAt(y1), rAt(y0), y1 - y0, 48)} material={i % 2 ? red : white} position={[0, TOP + (y0 + y1) / 2, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />;
      })}
      {/* door (faces +x) and small windows */}
      <group position={[rAt(1) - 0.02, TOP + 0.7, 0]}>
        <Slab min={[-0.05, 0, -0.55]} max={[0.12, 2.15, 0.55]} m={stone} />
        <Slab min={[0.1, 0.02, -0.45]} max={[0.16, 2.0, 0.45]} m={phys("lhDoor", { color: "#2f4a3c", roughness: 0.55, clearcoat: 0.3 })} />
        <mesh geometry={sphere(0.035, 10, 8)} material={MAT.brass()} position={[0.18, 1.0, 0.33]} />
        <Slab min={[0.0, -0.7, -0.7]} max={[0.75, 0.0, 0.7]} m={stone} />
      </group>
      {[[5.5, -Math.PI / 2], [9.5, Math.PI], [13.2, -Math.PI / 2 + 0.6], [7.5, 0.4]].map(([y, ang], i) => {
        const r = rAt(y);
        return (
          <group key={i} position={[Math.sin(ang) * r, TOP + y, Math.cos(ang) * r]} rotation={[0, ang, 0]}>
            <mesh geometry={box(0.42, 0.72, 0.1, 0.02)} material={stone} />
            <mesh geometry={box(0.3, 0.58, 0.04, 0.01)} material={phys("lhWin", { color: "#0c0f14", emissive: "#ffb46a", emissiveIntensity: 0.25 * dark, roughness: 0.2 })} position={[0, 0, 0.04]} />
          </group>
        );
      })}
      {/* gallery deck, corbels, railing */}
      <mesh geometry={cyl(2.75, 2.6, 0.3, 48)} material={stone} position={[0, DECK_Y - 0.15, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      {Array.from({ length: 16 }, (_, i) => {
        const ang = (i / 16) * Math.PI * 2;
        return <mesh key={i} geometry={box(0.18, 0.5, 0.6, 0.02)} material={white} position={[Math.sin(ang) * (LH.r1 + 0.35), DECK_Y - 0.5, Math.cos(ang) * (LH.r1 + 0.35)]} rotation={[0, ang, 0]} castShadow />;
      })}
      {Array.from({ length: 28 }, (_, i) => {
        const ang = (i / 28) * Math.PI * 2;
        return <mesh key={i} geometry={cyl(0.022, 0.022, 1.05, 6)} material={iron} position={[Math.sin(ang) * 2.6, DECK_Y + 0.52, Math.cos(ang) * 2.6]} castShadow />;
      })}
      {[1.05, 0.55].map((h) => <mesh key={h} geometry={torus(2.6, 0.028, 6, 96)} material={iron} position={[0, DECK_Y + h, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} castShadow />)}
      {/* lamp room */}
      <mesh geometry={cyl(LANTERN.r + 0.08, LANTERN.r + 0.1, 0.8, 32)} material={white} position={[0, DECK_Y + 0.4, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      <mesh geometry={cyl(LANTERN.r, LANTERN.r, 1.85, 32, true)} material={glass} position={[0, DECK_Y + 1.73, 0]} />
      {Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, i) => {
        const ang = (i / 10) * Math.PI * 2;
        return <mesh key={i} geometry={box(0.05, 1.9, 0.05, 0.005)} material={iron} position={[Math.sin(ang) * LANTERN.r, DECK_Y + 1.73, Math.cos(ang) * LANTERN.r]} castShadow />;
      })}
      {[DECK_Y + 0.82, DECK_Y + 2.65].map((y) => <mesh key={y} geometry={torus(LANTERN.r, 0.04, 6, 48)} material={iron} position={[0, y, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />)}
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.28, LANTERN.r + 0.32, 1.0, 32)} material={red} position={[0, LANTERN.y1 + 0.15, 0]} castShadow />
      <mesh geometry={sphere(0.3, 20, 14)} material={iron} position={[0, LANTERN.y1 + 0.85, 0]} castShadow />
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.02, 0.02, 1.1, 6)} material={iron} position={[0, LANTERN.y1 + 1.5, 0]} />
      {/* lens + bright core, turning */}
      <group position={LAMP} rotation={[0, a, 0]}>
        <mesh geometry={sphere(0.14, 20, 14)} material={core} />
        {[-0.3, -0.15, 0, 0.15, 0.3].map((y) => <mesh key={y} geometry={torus(0.42 - Math.abs(y) * 0.6, 0.05, 8, 32)} material={phys("lens", { color: "#c8dce4", roughness: 0.02, transparent: true, opacity: 0.35 })} position={[0, y, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />)}
        {[1, -1].map((s) => <mesh key={s} geometry={cyl(0.38, 0.38, 0.04, 28)} material={phys(`bullseye${Math.round(beam * 10)}`, { color: "#e8f4f8", roughness: 0.02, transparent: true, opacity: 0.4, emissive: "#fff0d0", emissiveIntensity: 0.22 * beam })} position={[0, 0, s * -0.5]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />)}
      </group>
      {/* beams read as volumes from afar; close to the lamp (on the gallery) they would be solid tubes */}
      {[0, Math.PI].map((o) => <Beam key={o} pos={LAMP} yaw={a + o} pitch={-0.015} len={160} radius={9} color="#fff2d6" i={0.55 * beam * dark * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (camD - 5) / 6))} />)}
      <Glow pos={LAMP} size={(2.2 + 14 * face ** 24) * near} color="#ffe9c4" i={beam * (0.35 + 0.65 * dark) * (0.5 + 0.5 * face ** 6) * near} />
    </group>
  );
};

// ── cottage ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const chartTex = () =>
  canvasTex("seaChart", 512, 360, (g, w, h) => {
    g.fillStyle = "#d9cfb3"; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    g.strokeStyle = "rgba(60,80,110,0.55)"; g.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, 60 + i * 50); for (let x = 0; x <= w; x += 16) g.lineTo(x, 60 + i * 50 + 18 * Math.sin(x * 0.02 + i)); g.stroke(); }
    g.fillStyle = "#8a7a58"; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(w, 0); g.lineTo(w * 0.62, 0); g.bezierCurveTo(w * 0.7, h * 0.3, w * 0.55, h * 0.5, w * 0.72, h); g.lineTo(w, h); g.fill();
    g.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,30,30,0.8)"; g.setLineDash([8, 6]); g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(w * 0.15, h * 0.8); g.lineTo(w * 0.6, h * 0.35); g.stroke();
  });
const logTex = () =>
  canvasTex("logbook", 512, 320, (g, w, h) => {
    g.fillStyle = "#efe6cf"; g.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
    g.strokeStyle = "rgba(90,110,160,0.35)"; g.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let y = 30; y < h; y += 18) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(10, y); g.lineTo(w - 10, y); g.stroke(); }
    g.strokeStyle = "rgba(40,40,60,0.75)"; g.lineWidth = 2;
    const r = mulberry32(4);
    for (let y = 26; y < h - 40; y += 18) { g.beginPath(); let x = 20; g.moveTo(x, y); while (x < (y > 200 ? 180 : w / 2 - 30)) { x += 6 + r() * 10; g.lineTo(x, y - r() * 6); } g.stroke(); }
    g.fillStyle = "rgba(60,60,60,0.4)"; g.fillRect(w / 2 - 2, 0, 4, h);
  });

const Cottage: React.FC<{ s: SetState; dark: number; inside: boolean; t: number }> = ({ s, dark, inside, t }) => {
  const { x0, x1, z0, z1, y, h, t: th } = COTTAGE;
  const wallOut = MAT.wall("#d9dcd6"), dado = MAT.dado("#4f6b6a"), roofM = phys("roof", { color: "#6e3426", roughness: 0.75 });
  const lamp = s.lamp ?? 1;
  const rise = 1.5, ov = 0.45, halfW = (z1 - z0) / 2 + ov, slope = Math.atan2(rise, halfW), L = Math.hypot(rise, halfW);
  const gable = useMemo(() => {
    const sh = new Shape();
    sh.moveTo(z0 - 0.02, 0); sh.lineTo(z1 + 0.02, 0); sh.lineTo((z0 + z1) / 2, rise); sh.closePath();
    return new ShapeGeometry(sh);
  }, [z0, z1]);
  return (
    <group>
      {/* foundation + floor */}
      <Slab min={[x0 - 0.1, TOP - 1.5, z0 - 0.1]} max={[x1 + 0.1, y - 0.1, z1 + 0.1]} m={phys("found", { color: "#6d675e", roughness: 0.95 })} />
      <Slab min={[x0, y - 0.12, z0]} max={[x1, y, z1]} m={MAT.planks([3, 3], "#c9a27a")} />
      <Slab min={[x0 - 0.6, TOP - 0.3, C_DOOR.z - 0.6]} max={[x0, y - 0.05, C_DOOR.z + 0.6]} m={phys("found", { color: "#6d675e", roughness: 0.95 })} />
      {/* walls */}
      <HoledWall axis="z" c={x0 + th / 2} a0={z0} a1={z1} y0={y} top={h} t={th} m={wallOut} dado={dado} holes={[{ a0: C_DOOR.z - C_DOOR.w / 2, a1: C_DOOR.z + C_DOOR.w / 2, y0: 0, y1: 2.05 }]} />
      <HoledWall axis="z" c={x1 - th / 2} a0={z0} a1={z1} y0={y} top={h} t={th} m={wallOut} dado={dado} holes={[{ a0: -1.1, a1: -0.2, y0: 1.0, y1: 1.9 }]} />
      <HoledWall axis="x" c={z0 + th / 2} a0={x0} a1={x1} y0={y} top={h} t={th} m={wallOut} dado={dado} holes={[{ a0: C_WIN.x - C_WIN.w / 2, a1: C_WIN.x + C_WIN.w / 2, y0: C_WIN.y0, y1: C_WIN.y1 }]} />
      <HoledWall axis="x" c={z1 - th / 2} a0={x0} a1={x1} y0={y} top={h} t={th} m={wallOut} dado={dado} holes={[{ a0: 8.3, a1: 9.1, y0: 1.1, y1: 1.85 }]} />
      {/* windows, door */}
      <Window at={[C_WIN.x, y + C_WIN.y0, z0 + th / 2]} axis="x" w={C_WIN.w} h={C_WIN.y1 - C_WIN.y0} />
      <Window at={[x1 - th / 2, y + 1.0, -0.65]} axis="z" w={0.9} h={0.9} />
      <Window at={[8.7, y + 1.1, z1 - th / 2]} axis="x" w={0.8} h={0.75} />
      <Door at={[x0 + th / 2, y, C_DOOR.z]} axis="z" w={C_DOOR.w} open={s.door ?? 0} inside={-1} leaf={phys("cDoor", { color: "#3d5a6e", roughness: 0.5, clearcoat: 0.3 })} />
      {/* roof: two pitches along x + gables */}
      {[1, -1].map((k) => (
        <mesh key={k} geometry={box(x1 - x0 + 2 * ov, 0.09, L, 0.01)} material={roofM} position={[(x0 + x1) / 2, y + h + rise / 2, (z0 + z1) / 2 + k * (halfW / 2)]} rotation={[k * slope, 0, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
      ))}
      {[x0, x1].map((x) => <mesh key={x} geometry={gable} material={wallOut} position={[x + (x === x0 ? 0.02 : -0.02), y + h, 0]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]} castShadow />)}
      {/* ceiling */}
      <Slab min={[x0 + th, y + h - 0.05, z0 + th]} max={[x1 - th, y + h, z1 - th]} m={MAT.planks([2, 2], "#b89a78")} />
      {/* porch lamp */}
      <mesh geometry={box(0.16, 0.22, 0.16, 0.02)} material={phys(`porch${Math.round(lamp * dark * 10)}`, { color: "#2a2620", emissive: "#ffb76e", emissiveIntensity: 2.5 * lamp * dark, roughness: 0.4 })} position={[x0 - 0.12, y + 2.35, C_DOOR.z + 0.62]} />
      {inside ? <Interior lamp={lamp} t={t} /> : null}
      {/* warm window glow seen from outside */}
      {!inside ? <Glow pos={[C_WIN.x, y + 1.5, z0 - 0.05]} size={2.4} color="#ffb05a" i={0.22 * lamp * dark} /> : null}
    </group>
  );
};

const Interior: React.FC<{ lamp: number; t: number }> = ({ lamp, t }) => {
  const y = COTTAGE.y;
  return (
    <group>
      <Desk at={DESK} w={1.5} d={0.66} top={DESK_TOP} wood="#6e4c30" />
      <Chair at={[DESK[0], y, DESK[2] + 0.75]} yaw={Math.PI} />
      {/* open logbook + pen, radio, mug, oil lamp */}
      <group position={[DESK[0] - 0.15, y + DESK_TOP + 0.012, DESK[2] + 0.06]} rotation={[0, 0.08, 0]}>
        <mesh geometry={box(0.42, 0.016, 0.3, 0.004)} material={phys("logCover", { color: "#4a2c1e", roughness: 0.7 })} />
        <mesh geometry={box(0.4, 0.004, 0.28, 0)} material={phys("logPages", { color: "#ffffff", map: logTex(), roughness: 0.85 })} position={[0, 0.011, 0]} />
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.004, 0.004, 0.14, 6)} material={phys("pen", { color: "#1d2b4a", roughness: 0.4 })} position={[0.12, 0.018, 0.05]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0.6]} />
      </group>
      <group position={[DESK[0] - 0.58, y + DESK_TOP, DESK[2] - 0.12]}>
        <mesh geometry={box(0.3, 0.2, 0.16, 0.02)} material={phys("radio", { color: "#5a4632", roughness: 0.6 })} position={[0, 0.1, 0]} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={box(0.16, 0.06, 0.01, 0.004)} material={phys("dial", { color: "#1a2a1a", emissive: "#7aff9a", emissiveIntensity: 0.6, roughness: 0.3 })} position={[0.03, 0.13, 0.082]} />
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.003, 0.003, 0.45, 6)} material={MAT.steel()} position={[-0.11, 0.42, 0]} rotation={[0, 0, 0.25]} />
      </group>
      <mesh geometry={cyl(0.04, 0.035, 0.09, 16)} material={MAT.plastic("#d9d2c2")} position={[DESK[0] + 0.15, y + DESK_TOP + 0.045, DESK[2] - 0.15]} castShadow />
      <OilLamp at={[DESK[0] + 0.5, y + DESK_TOP, DESK[2] - 0.05]} on={lamp * (0.94 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t * 13) * Math.sin(t * 7.3))} />
      <Bed at={BED_AT} yaw={Math.PI} L={1.9} W={0.92} blanket="#4a5a7a" />
      <Shelf at={[COTTAGE.x1 - COTTAGE.t, y + 1.55, 1.2]} yaw={-Math.PI / 2} w={1.2} />
      <WallClock at={[10.4, y + 2.05, COTTAGE.z1 - COTTAGE.t - 0.02]} yaw={Math.PI} time={2.3} />
      <mesh geometry={box(0.9, 0.62, 0.01, 0)} material={phys("chart", { color: "#ffffff", map: chartTex(), roughness: 0.8 })} position={[COTTAGE.x0 + COTTAGE.t + 0.01, y + 1.55, -1.3]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]} />
      {/* yellow raincoat on a hook by the door */}
      <mesh geometry={box(0.42, 0.95, 0.12, 0.05)} material={phys("raincoat", { color: "#d8a21e", roughness: 0.4, clearcoat: 0.6 })} position={[COTTAGE.x0 + COTTAGE.t + 0.08, y + 1.35, 1.55]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0.04]} castShadow />
      <mesh geometry={box(1.6, 0.012, 1.0, 0.004)} material={MAT.fabric("rug", "#7a3a2a", "#c9a26a")} position={[9.3, y + 0.006, 0.4]} receiveShadow />
      <Dust min={[COTTAGE.x0 + 0.3, y + 0.2, COTTAGE.z0 + 0.3]} max={[COTTAGE.x1 - 0.3, y + 2.4, COTTAGE.z1 - 0.3]} n={200} t={t} i={0.25} size={0.008} color="#ffd9b0" />
    </group>
  );
};

// ── the boat and its lamps (the "light at sea") ─────────────────────────────

const Boat: React.FC<{ t: number; amp: number; seaLight: number; boat: number; fog: number; cam: Cam }> = ({ t, amp, seaLight, boat, fog, cam }) => {
  const hy = waveHeight(BOAT[0], BOAT[2], t, amp) * 0.85;
  const [sx, sz] = waveSlope(BOAT[0], BOAT[2], t, amp);
  const hull = phys("hull", { color: "#2c4a6a", roughness: 0.6 }), stripe = phys("hullStripe", { color: "#e6e0d0", roughness: 0.6 }), wood = MAT.wood("#5a4030");
  // blink: the lamps dip behind the swells now and then (their reflection on the water comes from the point light)
  const blink = 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, 0.5 + 0.9 * (Math.sin(t * 1.25) + 0.6 * Math.sin(t * 0.71 + 1.0))));
  const on = Math.max(seaLight * blink, boat);
  const lampM = phys(`boatLamp${Math.round(on * 10)}`, { color: "#fff8e8", emissive: "#ffe4b0", emissiveIntensity: 8 * on, roughness: 0.2 });
  const dist = Math.hypot(cam.pos[0] - SEA_LIGHT[0], cam.pos[2] - SEA_LIGHT[2]);
  const far = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (dist - 30) / 120));
  return (
    <group>
      <group position={[BOAT[0], hy, BOAT[2]]} rotation={[sz * 0.8, BOAT_YAW, -sx * 0.8]}>
        <mesh geometry={cached("boatHull", () => new IcosahedronGeometry(1, 3))} material={hull} scale={[1.15, 0.7, 5.0]} position={[0, 0.25, 0]} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={box(1.7, 0.06, 7.6, 0.03)} material={wood} position={[0, 0.72, 0]} castShadow receiveShadow />
        <mesh geometry={box(2.2, 0.12, 0.12, 0.02)} material={stripe} position={[0, 0.62, 3.2]} />
        <mesh geometry={box(1.3, 0.85, 1.5, 0.05)} material={phys("cabin", { color: "#c9b48a", roughness: 0.7 })} position={[0, 1.18, 2.0]} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={box(1.55, 0.06, 1.8, 0.02)} material={phys("cabinRoof", { color: "#3a5a7a", roughness: 0.6 })} position={[0, 1.64, 2.0]} rotation={[0.08, 0, 0]} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.07, 0.09, 5.2, 8)} material={wood} position={[0, 2.95, -0.6]} castShadow />
        <mesh geometry={cyl(0.04, 0.04, 3.4, 6)} material={wood} position={[0, 4.2, -0.6]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2]} />
        {[-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5].map((x) => <mesh key={x} geometry={sphere(0.14, 12, 8)} material={lampM} position={[x, 4.05, -0.6]} />)}
        {/* outriggers (cadik) */}
        {[1, -1].map((k) => (
          <group key={k}>
            <mesh geometry={cyl(0.12, 0.12, 8.5, 8)} material={wood} position={[k * 2.6, 0.1, 0]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} />
            {[-2.2, 2.2].map((z) => <mesh key={z} geometry={cyl(0.05, 0.05, 2.7, 6)} material={wood} position={[k * 1.35, 0.55, z]} rotation={[0, 0, Math.PI / 2 - k * 0.2]} />)}
          </group>
        ))}
      </group>
      {/* the light as seen from far away: glow + halo in fog + its streak on the water */}
      <Glow pos={[SEA_LIGHT[0], SEA_LIGHT[1] + hy, SEA_LIGHT[2]]} size={(3 + 4 * fog) * (0.4 + 0.6 * far)} color="#ffe8c4" i={on * (0.55 + 0.45 * far)} />
      <Glow pos={[SEA_LIGHT[0], SEA_LIGHT[1] + hy, SEA_LIGHT[2]]} size={(6 + 7 * fog) * far} color="#c8d8ff" i={on * fog * 0.14 * far} />
    </group>
  );
};

// ── the world ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const TIME_SKY: Record<string, { look: keyof typeof SKIES; dir: V3; dark: number; sea: string }> = {
  night: { look: "night", dir: MOON, dark: 1, sea: "#08141f" },
  dusk: { look: "dusk", dir: [0.6, 0.12, -0.78], dark: 0.6, sea: "#1a2232" },
  dawn: { look: "dawn", dir: SUN_DAWN, dark: 0.35, sea: "#1d3346" },
  day: { look: "day", dir: [0.4, 0.75, -0.5], dark: 0, sea: "#1d4258" },
};

export const CoastSet: React.FC<{ place: string; time: string; s: SetState; t: number; cam: Cam }> = ({ place, time, s, t, cam }) => {
  const T = TIME_SKY[time] ?? TIME_SKY.night;
  const inside = place === "cottage";
  const amp = s.waves ?? 1;
  return (
    <group>
      <SkyDome look={SKIES[T.look]} dir={T.dir} cam={cam.pos} t={t} />
      <Ocean t={t} amp={amp} color={T.sea} />
      <mesh geometry={terrainGeo()} material={terrainMat} receiveShadow castShadow />
      <Rocks />
      <Grass t={t} />
      <Fence />
      <Bench />
      <Lighthouse t={t} beam={s.beam ?? 1} dark={T.dark} cam={cam} />
      <Cottage s={s} dark={T.dark} inside={inside} t={t} />
      <Boat t={t} amp={amp} seaLight={(s.seaLight ?? 0) * (0.3 + 0.7 * T.dark)} boat={s.boat ?? 0} fog={s.fog ?? 0.3} cam={cam} />
      {place === "gallery" ? <Dust min={[-3, DECK_Y, -3]} max={[3, DECK_Y + 3, 3]} n={140} t={t} i={0.18} size={0.012} /> : null}
    </group>
  );
};

type TimeLook = { bg: string; fog: string; hemiSky: string; hemiGround: string; hemi: number; key: string; keyI: number; dir: [number, number, number]; env: number; fill: string; dark: number };
const TIMES: Record<string, TimeLook> = {
  night: { bg: "#050913", fog: "#0c1626", hemiSky: "#2b3f66", hemiGround: "#0b0c0e", hemi: 0.5, key: "#a8c0ff", keyI: 2.4, dir: MOON, env: 0.05, fill: "#3e5c96", dark: 1 },
  dusk: { bg: "#2a2a3e", fog: "#6a5a68", hemiSky: "#7a7aa0", hemiGround: "#2a2018", hemi: 0.9, key: "#ffb27a", keyI: 2.6, dir: [0.6, 0.12, -0.78], env: 0.18, fill: "#8a6a7a", dark: 0.6 },
  dawn: { bg: "#5a6a88", fog: "#9a9aa8", hemiSky: "#a8b8d8", hemiGround: "#3a3028", hemi: 1.1, key: "#ffd2a0", keyI: 3.0, dir: SUN_DAWN, env: 0.3, fill: "#a0a8c0", dark: 0.35 },
  day: { bg: "#9ab8d8", fog: "#b8c8d8", hemiSky: "#cfe0f2", hemiGround: "#5a5040", hemi: 1.4, key: "#fff4e0", keyI: 3.4, dir: [0.4, 0.75, -0.5], env: 0.5, fill: "#c0d0e0", dark: 0 },
};

const pt = (pos: [number, number, number], color: string, i: number, dist: number): PointL => (i > 0.001 ? { pos, color, i, dist } : P_OFF);

const light = (place: string, time: string, s: SetState, t: number): LightState => {
  const T = TIMES[time] ?? TIMES.night;
  const fog = s.fog ?? 0.3, beam = s.beam ?? 1, lamp = s.lamp ?? 1, seaL = s.seaLight ?? 0, boat = s.boat ?? 0;
  const dark = T.dark;
  if (place === "cottage") {
    // the lamp beam sweeps past the sea window twice a revolution: a cold flash through the glass
    const a = beamAngle(t), toWin = Math.atan2(C_WIN.x, COTTAGE.z0);
    const flash = beam * dark * Math.max(0, Math.cos(a - toWin)) ** 40 + beam * dark * Math.max(0, Math.cos(a + Math.PI - toWin)) ** 40;
    return {
      bg: T.bg, fog: { color: T.fog, density: 0.0035 + 0.011 * fog }, env: T.env * 0.6 + 0.03,
      hemi: { sky: T.hemiSky, ground: "#1a120c", i: T.hemi * 0.55 },
      moon: { dir: T.dir, color: T.key, i: T.keyI * 0.75, box: { min: [COTTAGE.x0, COTTAGE.y - 0.2, COTTAGE.z0 - 0.5], max: [COTTAGE.x1, COTTAGE.y + COTTAGE.h, COTTAGE.z1] } },
      spots: [S_OFF, S_OFF],
      pts: [
        pt([DESK[0] + 0.5, COTTAGE.y + DESK_TOP + 0.3, DESK[2] + 0.1], "#ffb257", 1.7 * lamp * (0.4 + 0.6 * dark), 6),
        pt([DESK[0] + 0.3, COTTAGE.y + COTTAGE.h - 0.1, DESK[2] + 0.8], "#ff9a50", 0.7 * lamp * dark, 6),
        pt([C_WIN.x, COTTAGE.y + 1.6, COTTAGE.z0 + 0.6], T.fill, 0.6 + 0.6 * (1 - dark), 4.5),
        pt([C_WIN.x, COTTAGE.y + 1.5, COTTAGE.z0 + 1.4], "#fff2d8", 3 * flash, 7),
        P_OFF, P_OFF,
      ],
    };
  }
  const gal = place === "gallery";
  const atSea = place === "sea";
  const box = atSea ? { min: [BOAT[0] - 10, -2, BOAT[2] - 10] as [number, number, number], max: [BOAT[0] + 10, 8, BOAT[2] + 10] as [number, number, number] } : gal ? { min: [-4, DECK_Y - 1, -4] as [number, number, number], max: [4, DECK_Y + 4, 4] as [number, number, number] } : { min: [-14, TOP - 3, -12] as [number, number, number], max: [15, TOP + 18, 6] as [number, number, number] };
  return {
    bg: T.bg, fog: { color: T.fog, density: 0.0035 + 0.011 * fog }, env: T.env,
    hemi: { sky: T.hemiSky, ground: T.hemiGround, i: T.hemi },
    moon: { dir: T.dir, color: T.key, i: T.keyI, box },
    spots: [
      dark > 0.2 ? { pos: [COTTAGE.x0 - 0.35, TOP + 2.55, C_DOOR.z], target: [COTTAGE.x0 - 2.2, TOP, C_DOOR.z], color: "#ffb76e", i: 7 * lamp * dark, angle: 0.95, penumbra: 0.8, dist: 10 } : S_OFF,
      S_OFF,
    ],
    pts: [
      pt(LAMP, "#ffdcaa", (gal ? 1.6 : 9) * beam * (0.3 + 0.7 * dark), gal ? 6 : 22),
      pt([C_WIN.x, TOP + 1.5, COTTAGE.z0 - 0.7], "#ffb46a", 1.4 * lamp * dark, 6),
      pt([SEA_LIGHT[0], SEA_LIGHT[1] + 1, SEA_LIGHT[2] + 3], "#ffe9c0", 60 * Math.max(seaL, boat), 70),
      pt([BOAT[0] + 6, 6, BOAT[2] + 10], "#ffe2b0", 40 * boat, 30),
      P_OFF,
      pt(atSea ? [BOAT[0] + 8, 10, BOAT[2] + 14] : gal ? [2.5, DECK_Y + 2.5, -3] : [4, TOP + 5, -4], T.fill, 0.8, gal ? 9 : 26),
    ],
  };
};

  places: { cliff, gallery, cottage, sea },

    fog: { default: 0.3, doc: "sea fog (0 clear, 1 thick; the sea light gets a big halo)" },

==== 2539 project/src/worlds/coast/layout.ts
// The coast: one coordinate plan for the headland, lighthouse, keeper's cottage, sea and the boat. Units
// metres, y up, sea level y = 0, the sea lies toward −z. Every place, light and camera reads these numbers.

import { fbm } from "../../kits/worldforge/noise.ts";
import type { V3 } from "../types.ts";

/** Plateau height of the headland. */
export const TOP = 12;
/** Coastline (cliff edge) z for an x; land is z greater than this. */
export const coastZ = (x: number) => -9 + 0.0035 * x * x + 0.8 * Math.sin(x * 0.21) + 0.5 * Math.sin(x * 0.53 + 1);

const sstep = (a: number, b: number, x: number) => { const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (x - a) / (b - a))); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };

/** Terrain height (headland plateau, cliff, seabed). Flattened around the buildings and paths. */
export const ground = (x: number, z: number) => {
  const d = z - coastZ(x) + 0.5 * fbm(x * 0.3 + 11, z * 0.3, 3);
  const flat = sstep(14, 6, Math.hypot(Math.max(0, Math.abs(x - 5) - 7), Math.max(0, Math.abs(z) - 4)));
  const plateau = TOP + 2.8 * sstep(10, 70, z) + (1 - flat) * 0.35 * fbm(x * 0.05, z * 0.05, 3) + 0.07 * fbm(x * 0.6, z * 0.6, 2);
  const cliff = sstep(-2.2, 1.0, d);
  const rock = (1 - cliff) * cliff * 3.5 * fbm(x * 0.9, z * 0.9 + 3, 3);
  const sea = -4 - 0.06 * Math.max(0, -d);
  return sea + (plateau - sea) * cliff + rock;
};

export const LH = { x: 0, z: 0, r0: 2.3, r1: 1.62, h: 16 };
export const DECK_Y = TOP + LH.h + 0.3;
export const LANTERN = { r: 1.35, y0: DECK_Y, y1: DECK_Y + 3.0 };
export const LAMP: V3 = [0, DECK_Y + 1.5, 0];
/** Seconds per revolution of the lamp (two opposite beams). */
export const BEAM_PERIOD = 10;
export const beamAngle = (t: number) => (t / BEAM_PERIOD) * Math.PI * 2;

export const COTTAGE = { x0: 7, x1: 13, z0: -2.6, z1: 2.6, y: TOP + 0.15, h: 2.6, t: 0.18 };
export const C_DOOR = { z: 0.6, w: 0.9 };
export const C_WIN = { x: 10.2, w: 1.4, y0: 0.95, y1: 2.05 };
export const DESK: V3 = [10.2, COTTAGE.y, -2.08];
export const DESK_TOP = 0.76;
export const BED_AT: V3 = [11.9, COTTAGE.y, 1.5];

/** The light at sea (a fishing boat's lamps, seen from the headland). */
export const BOAT: V3 = [-48, 0, -235];
export const BOAT_YAW = 0.6;
export const SEA_LIGHT: V3 = [BOAT[0], 4.2, BOAT[2]];

/** Direction toward the moon (over the sea, a little left). */
export const MOON: V3 = [-0.33, 0.42, -0.84];

==== 8181 project/src/worlds/kos/data.ts
// Kos world (an Indonesian boarding house, from Dunia Nabel EP01): a bedroom, the long hallway with seven
// room doors, the end of the hallway (gudang door, vent, a raincoat on a hook, small window, water
// dispenser) and the front yard with the terrace lamp, gate and street.

import { P_OFF, S_OFF, type LightState } from "../../cine/types.ts";
import type { Place, SetState, WorldData } from "../types.ts";
import { BED, CCTV, CEIL, DESK, DISPENSER, DOORS, END_Z, ENTRANCE_Z, FAN, GATE, HALL, MARK_CREEP, MARK_STOP, ROOM_DOOR, RAINCOAT_HOOK, ROOM, ROOM_WIN, SMALL_WIN, SOCKET, STREET_LAMP, TERRACE_LAMP, TUBES, VENT, WALL, WARDROBE, YARD } from "./layout.ts";
import { L_DAY_EXT, L_EXT, L_HALL, L_HALL_LIT, L_ROOM, L_ROOM_DAY } from "./looks.ts";

/** the hallway light switch beside the bedroom door (left wall) */
const SWITCH: [number, number, number] = [HALL.x0 + 0.01, 1.35, ROOM_DOOR.z + ROOM_DOOR.w / 2 + 0.2];

const room: Place = {
  id: "room", doc: "a small kos bedroom: bed under the window, desk with an LED clock, standing fan, wardrobe, door to the hallway",

    door: { p: [HALL.x0 - 0.65, ROOM_DOOR.z], yaw: Math.PI / 2, doc: "inside the door, facing it" },
    window: { p: [ROOM.x0 + 0.65, (ROOM_WIN.z0 + ROOM_WIN.z1) / 2], yaw: -Math.PI / 2, doc: "at the window" },
    middle: { p: [-2.6, -5.4], yaw: Math.PI / 2, doc: "middle of the room" },
  },
  pois: {

  solids: [
    { min: [BED.x0, 0, BED.z0], max: [BED.x1, 0.75, BED.z1] },
    { min: [DESK.x0, 0, DESK.z - DESK.d], max: [DESK.x1, 0.95, DESK.z] },
    { min: [WARDROBE.x0, 0, WARDROBE.z - WARDROBE.d], max: [WARDROBE.x1, WARDROBE.h, WARDROBE.z] },

  establish: { center: [-2.6, 1.0, -5.5], radius: 1.6, height: 1.5, yaw: 0.9 },
  view: "door", window: "window", ambience: "room", surface: "tile", reverb: 0.2,
};

const light = (place: string, time: string, s: SetState): LightState => {
  const day = time === "day";
  if (place === "room") return day ? L_ROOM_DAY : L_ROOM;
  if (place === "yard") return day ? L_DAY_EXT : L_EXT;
  const lit = (s.tubes ?? 0) > 0.5 || day;
  return lit ? L_HALL_LIT : L_HALL;
};
void P_OFF; void S_OFF;

export const KOS: WorldData = {
  id: "kos",
  doc: "an Indonesian boarding house (kos): bedroom, long hallway with seven doors, the front yard (from Dunia Nabel EP01)",
  places: { room, hall, yard },
  times: ["night", "day"],
  props: {
    door: { default: 0, doc: "the bedroom door (0 shut, 1 wide open)", sfx: { up: "door-open", down: "door-close" } },
    tubes: { default: 0, doc: "hallway ceiling lamps (0 off — moonlit, 1 on)", sfx: { up: "click", down: "click" } },
    fan: { default: 1, doc: "the standing fan in the bedroom turning (0 off, 1 on)" },
    vent: { default: 0, doc: "the loose vent flap at the end of the hallway rattles (0 still, 1 rattling)", sfx: { up: "knock" } },
    coat: { default: 1, doc: "the long black raincoat hanging at the end of the hallway (0 gone, 1 there)" },
    pile: { default: 0, doc: "clothes piled on the desk chair (0 none, 1 a pile that looks like someone sitting)" },
    gudang: { default: 0, doc: "the storage-room door at the end (0 shut, 1 open)", sfx: { up: "door-open", down: "door-close" } },
  },
  light: (p, t, s) => light(p, t, s),
};
